title: Get AdCP Capabilities Request
description: Request payload for get_adcp_capabilities task. Protocol-level capability discovery that works across all AdCP protocols.
x-tool-summary: Discover the AdCP protocols and feature sets supported by this agent.

protocols.description: Specific protocols to query capabilities for. If omitted, returns capabilities for all supported protocols.

scope.description: Selects how much of the capabilities document the responder returns. `full` (the default, and the behavior when omitted) returns the whole document. `signing_discovery` is the scope a verifier MUST request on the signing-key discovery path (see security.mdx, 'Discovering an agent's signing keys via brand_json_url'): the responder returns only `adcp` (`major_versions` and `idempotency`), `supported_protocols`, `identity`, `request_signing`, and `webhook_signing`, and omits every other block, so a large `creative.supported_formats` catalog or any other declaration cannot push the document past the verifier's `MAX_CAPABILITIES_BYTES` fetch budget. A responder that declares any signing posture MUST honor `signing_discovery`. A responder that predates 3.3 ignores the field and returns the full document, which stays subject to `MAX_CAPABILITIES_BYTES`. A `signing_discovery` response is not a complete capabilities document: a caller MUST NOT cache it as one or use its absent blocks to infer that the agent lacks a capability. Combining `scope: "signing_discovery"` with `protocols[]` is permitted and `protocols[]` is ignored.
